rows.grounds: fused form: tilān (sesame seeds) + nikṣipya (absolutive of ni-√kṣip, having placed)

items.question: What materials and vessel are prescribed for the ritual placement following the prepared seat?
premises: Sesame seeds are to be placed as part of the action.
The placement is made in a bronze vessel.
A new fruit accompanies the placement in the vessel.
items.inference: The prescribed ritual action is to place sesame seeds in a bronze vessel together with a new fruit.
uncertainties: The specific identity or type of the navaphala (new fruit) is not specified.
items.plain_english: Then, having placed sesame seeds in a bronze vessel, do so together with a new fruit.
